children.description: Oink 0.8.0 adds two opt-in output formats for readers that arrive as programs — a full-text bundle holding an entire section in one file, and a navigation tree published as JSON — plus static backlinks, which list the pages that link to a page in its right rail. All three stay off until you ask.
children.title: Oink v0.8.0

children.description: Oink 0.7.1 is a security and validation patch. Swagger UI stops sending your spec URL to a third party, misconfigured values warn instead of killing an ordinary build, and the OpenAPI and terminal components finally behave in print, Markdown and RSS the way every other component already did.
children.title: Oink v0.7.1

children.description: Oink 0.7.0 gives a section its own accent through the shell's grounds, hands the site control of all seven typography roles, and turns a Mermaid fence into a figure that is centred, redrawn in place on a colour-scheme change, and openable at its own size.
children.title: Oink v0.7.0

children.description: Oink 0.6.0 adds an immersive presentation to the existing Blog shell, completes Blog publishing with images, authors, series, three index forms and sharing, and replaces build-stopping template errors with safe warnings.
children.title: Oink v0.6.0

children.description: Oink 0.5.0 replaces most shortcodes with native Markdown forms, converges every configuration and front matter key on three rules, removes the 0.x compatibility layer, and ships the migration toolkit that rewrites a 0.4 site. Every old key, shape, and shortcode fails the build with its replacement instead of being silently ignored.
children.title: Oink v0.5.0

children.description: Oink 0.4.0 adds sequential reading and release surfaces, reusable landing pages, Book publishing with stable references, and a keyboard-first site shell in one consolidated Scenario Components release.
children.title: Oink v0.4.0

children.title: Oink v0.3.0
